templates.title: Reply to client interest
templates.subject: Thanks for your interest in {{service_name}}
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

thanks for reaching out and for your interest in {{service_name}}.
I would be happy to help.

Could you please share:
- what exactly you need,
- your ideal timeline,
- and your budget (if available)?

Then I can suggest the next best step.

Thanks,
{{sender_name}}
templates.ai_prompt: Write a professional and friendly reply to a client who expressed interest in {{service_name}}. Address them as {{name}}. Ask for their requirements, timeline, and budget. Keep it warm, concise, and under 100 words.

templates.title: Follow-up reminder
templates.subject: Quick follow-up on {{topic}}
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

just following up on my previous email about {{topic}}.
Is this still relevant for you?

If yes, just reply and I will propose the next step.

Thanks,
{{sender_name}}
templates.ai_prompt: Write a short, polite follow-up email to {{name}} about {{topic}}. Keep it brief — two sentences max. Friendly but professional. Do not sound pushy.

templates.title: Polite rejection
templates.subject: Thank you for reaching out
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

thank you for your message about {{topic}}.
Unfortunately, I cannot take this on right now.

I do not want to commit to something I cannot deliver well and on time.
If helpful, I can recommend an alternative.

Thanks for understanding,
{{sender_name}}
templates.ai_prompt: Write a polite rejection email to {{name}} about {{topic}}. Be warm and empathetic. Explain you cannot commit right now without over-explaining. Offer to recommend someone else. Keep it under 80 words.

templates.title: Send proposal / offer
templates.subject: Proposal for {{project_name}}
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

thank you for the conversation — it was great to learn more about what you need.

I have prepared a proposal for {{project_name}}. You can find it attached / at the link below.

Happy to walk you through it on a quick call if that helps.

Looking forward to hearing from you,
{{sender_name}}
templates.ai_prompt: Write a professional email to {{name}} sending a proposal for {{project_name}}. Mention the proposal is attached. Offer a quick call to walk through it. Keep it friendly and under 80 words.

templates.title: Confirm a meeting
templates.subject: Confirmed: {{meeting_topic}} on {{date}}
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

just confirming our meeting on {{date}} at {{time}}.

We will cover: {{meeting_topic}}.

If anything changes, please let me know in advance.

See you then,
{{sender_name}}
templates.ai_prompt: Write a short meeting confirmation email to {{name}} for a meeting on {{date}} at {{time}} about {{meeting_topic}}. Keep it professional and under 60 words.
